title: The Bells
summary: The Drowned Abbey's bells rang three nights running, and Sister Orla says the Cult has a man at the choir's door. She'd go herself, and the Mother would have her sent further than Saltmere.

steps.journal: Go into the Drowned Abbey, out past the Sickpools. Brother Teague waits at the choir's door, in the first floor's hall. Break his cage, then him.

ready: Brother Teague is down. Tell Sister Orla, at the Grey Sisters' chapel in Saltmere.
done: Orla wrote Teague's name in the chapel's book, under the names he'd taken. She said it was the least he was owed.
